name: CORTEX
user: A researcher must decide whether two coastal measurements support a contradiction.
action: Enter “pressure”, follow row 1, inspect the source and its offset, then mark Supports. Compare sampling locations before answering.
metrics: Compare weighted reading with keyword and source-order controls. Comprehension and decision accuracy score keyed answers. Time and optional effort describe individual attempts.
limit: Lexical similarity identifies shared terms. The four notes and scripted response do not establish reduced cognitive load at scale.
baseline: Weighted reading vs keyword or source order
sample: 4 authored field notes; one scripted attempt

nodes.title: Collection
nodes.impl: Split nonblank source at bounded chunks, preserving row and offset.

nodes.title: Explore relationships
nodes.impl: Rank weighted terms or compare against keyword and source order.

nodes.title: Inspect original
nodes.impl: Follow the row and offset to read the original and check context.

nodes.title: Evidence sufficient?
nodes.impl: The reader decides whether the passage supports a conclusion.

nodes.title: Explore more
nodes.impl: Follow peer links or refine the search terms.

nodes.title: Annotate and decide
nodes.impl: Mark support, conflict or an open question.

nodes.title: Score the task
nodes.input: Keyed decision, time and optional effort
nodes.impl: Compare the authored response with the answer key and export.

name: SUPPLY
user: A planner needs to know which order will miss its customer request date and why.
action: Delay supplier P1. Compare O1 against the fixture at the same simulated day. Reset before approving the original shortage proposal.
metrics: Six authored snapshots: CRD risk precision 1.0, recall 1.0; reactive recall 0. Three warnings were 5, 3 and 5 days early. Four dated shipments had mean absolute error 0 days.
limit: The arrival assumption drives projected shipment. Planner outcomes and actual supplier commitments are unmeasured. Duplicate events are rejected.
baseline: Dated allocation vs reactive risk flag

nodes.title: Inventory events
nodes.impl: Choose the sample ledger or append a validated simulation event.

nodes.title: Validate event
nodes.impl: Reject malformed events and duplicate IDs before allocation.

nodes.title: Replay and allocate
nodes.impl: Allocate stock first and then incoming lots in booking order.

nodes.title: CRD at risk?
nodes.impl: Count units unavailable by the customer request date.

nodes.title: Monitor
nodes.impl: Continue monitoring the ledger and stale-feed indicator.

nodes.title: Investigate shortage
nodes.impl: A late lot explains risk. A purchase proposal requires missing units.

nodes.title: Approve purchase?
nodes.impl: Validate chosen quantity before applying the simulated approval.

nodes.title: Reject or hold
nodes.impl: Retain current state or record a simulated rejection.

nodes.title: Compare and audit
nodes.input: Current and starting ledger at the same day
nodes.impl: Inspect shortage and projected ship dates at the same clock time.

name: SYMBIOSIS
user: An operator wants a feasible steering proposal while retaining control over the selection.
action: Choose an objective, inspect the proposal, approve it, then undo. Pause or abort a pending sweep to retain control.
metrics: Compare approval mode with the sequential form. Record decision history, completion time and optional trust/control ratings. No participant comparison is available.
limit: Algorithmic proposals operate over a bounded sweep. A feasible point can have unknown nDCG when relevance labels are absent.

nodes.title: Objective
nodes.impl: Choose maximize gain or minimize drift.

nodes.title: Compute alternatives
nodes.impl: Sweep bounded signed strengths and compute gain, drift, cosine and optional nDCG.

nodes.title: Feasible proposal?
nodes.impl: Filter for feasibility and choose the objective-ordered frontier recommendation.

nodes.title: Edit or pause
nodes.input: No positive-gain proposal or changed limits
nodes.impl: Pause or abort pending work. Editing constraints recomputes when enabled.

nodes.title: Human approval?
nodes.impl: Inspect measured differences before approving the reversible local selection.

nodes.title: Retain selection
nodes.impl: Rejection retains the operator’s selected point.

nodes.title: Apply and undo
nodes.impl: Inspect ranked documents and undo to the previous point.

nodes.title: Decision history
nodes.impl: Record observed actions and completion time; ratings require operator input.

name: MORPH
user: A workspace user wants a shorter route to a frequently useful destination.
action: Enable learning, record CORTEX as preferred, inspect the counts and accept. Undo returns to the preceding layout.
metrics: Static and adaptive trials can log task duration, route changes, errors and optional effort. The estimate (1 + positive)/(2 + positive + negative) describes recorded signals.
limit: The tab retains up to 256 events. Scripted acceptance is a functional check. Causal usability benefit requires independent participants.
sample: One scripted tab; no independent participants

nodes.title: Consent?
nodes.impl: Only opt-in module names, actions and timestamps enter tab memory.

nodes.title: Static navigation
nodes.impl: The operator can continue without accepting a layout change.

nodes.title: Record interactions
nodes.impl: Keep up to 256 events; document and query text are excluded.

nodes.title: Sufficient signal?
nodes.impl: Smooth reward counts and require a positive signal for a suggestion.

nodes.title: Recommend
nodes.impl: Show reward counts and retain the current layout while waiting.

nodes.title: Accept shortcut?
nodes.impl: A human chooses the adaptation.

nodes.title: Apply shortcut
nodes.impl: A shortcut navigates to the chosen workspace.

nodes.title: Compare and reset
nodes.impl: Inspect completed trials, undo the adaptation or delete local history.

name: VECTOR-X
official: Embedding Model with Vector Steering and Semantic Space Visualizer
user: A retrieval engineer needs to explain a rank change while limiting movement along a protected model direction.
action: Select a corpus and hash-bound encoder. Define a query and expected IDs. Apply Semantic Lock with the Adaptive Governor. Inspect the dense baseline, constrained candidate, violations and per-task gate.
metrics: Recall@K counts labeled coverage; nDCG@K discounts lower ranks. Drift and retained cosine test endpoint geometry. Projection overlap measures how many full-space neighbors survive in 3D.
limit: PCA is a display branch off the full-dimensional model space. It supplies no retrieval scores. A passed geometric constraint does not establish protected human meaning.

nodes.title: Dataset and labels
nodes.input: Calibration rows or bounded private import
nodes.impl: Choose and map text. Reject malformed or over-limit records.

nodes.title: Select encoder
nodes.input: Local model selection and expected identity
nodes.impl: Verify the installed basis and derive directions within it.

nodes.title: Embed query
nodes.impl: Encode representable documents and the query.

nodes.title: Representable?
nodes.impl: A missing vector leaves dense methods unranked.

nodes.title: Lexical fallback
nodes.impl: Report the abstention and compare rank fusion where possible.

nodes.title: Original retrieval
nodes.impl: Rank by full-dimensional similarity with the versioned tie policy.

nodes.title: Target and protection
nodes.impl: Choose the target, protected direction, drift cap and cosine floor.

nodes.title: Constraints met?
nodes.impl: Semantic Lock projects the direction. The governor tests signed gain, drift and retained cosine.

nodes.title: Reduce or retain
nodes.impl: Search the grid and disclose why a step was reduced or rejected.

nodes.title: Compare rankings
nodes.input: Baseline and candidate against fixed judgments
nodes.impl: Inspect missed IDs and geometry separately.

nodes.title: Quality gate?
nodes.impl: Evaluate every task and aggregate the release decision.

nodes.title: Blocked configuration
nodes.impl: Keep the full report even when a configuration is blocked.

nodes.title: Export and replay
nodes.input: Model hash, dataset fingerprint and settings
nodes.impl: Download the JSON and replay locally with the same verified encoder.

nodes.title: PCA display only
nodes.impl: Project coordinates for inspection. Retrieval uses the original dimensions.

name: CLARITY
official: Ambiguity Identification and Resolution in Natural Language
user: An operator needs to resolve an ambiguous instruction before a simulated action proceeds.
action: Inspect “Send it”. Identify the pronoun, enter “ocean waves”, confirm it and compare retrieved passages. The original reading may have no vector.
metrics: Six authored ambiguous cases were detected and localized. Two unambiguous controls were correctly left alone; the lexical baseline detected one positive. Independent resolution quality is open.
limit: Finite English rules can miss ambiguities. Weights are heuristic. A zero-vector reading has unavailable similarity. No external action runs.

nodes.title: Instruction
nodes.impl: Inspect the submitted instruction without executing it.

nodes.title: Locate ambiguity
nodes.impl: Mark recognized cues and rank clarification questions with heuristic weights.

nodes.title: User confirms?
nodes.impl: Ask the operator to supply an entity, reference frame or alternative.

nodes.title: Clarify or defer
nodes.impl: Preserve partial answers; a consequential verb can trigger DEFER.

nodes.title: Compare readings
nodes.impl: Encode each reading with its own deadline and disclose excluded vocabulary.

nodes.title: Transfer or export
nodes.impl: The operator can open the confirmed reading in Vector Warp or export the record.
